sources: GOSPOLI111 and DISARIN111 current course evidence
OER Mental Health in Crisis module
academicFindings.finding: Mind, consciousness, selfhood, emotion, responsibility and independent philosophical argument form sustained direct study. Psychopathology actually addresses historical views, diagnostic classification, stigma and biopsychosocial explanation, providing a material subject connection to Mental Health in Crisis. Clinical assessment/treatment, lifespan and cognitive study complement that foundation. They do not by themselves implement philosophical psychiatry, neurodiversity or professional clinical qualification, and these gaps are explicit in the displayed concept. Logic adds formal reasoning/proof; it is not claimed as a full philosophical textual-methods sequence.

The primary still joins ethics, political thought and philosophical mind/self/emotion with institutions, constitutional/international law and social research. The second changes emphasis to climate science, environmental media, communication, governance and documentary methods while retaining philosophy. Their six-course45EC difference is substantive. The mental-health route differs by12/13 courses from the retained routes because of actual clinical/cognitive/methodological priorities, not arbitrary swaps.
